//: Typecheck config for @continuum/experience-view. Mirrors chat-view's strict contract; compiles against the SDK + patterns source (workspace resolves to ./index.ts, no build step). Framework-free and platform-neutral, so NO DOM lib — it must typecheck the same under a browser bundler (apps/web), Node (apps/tui), and a mobile/RAG target. tsc is --noEmit typecheck only; each consumer's bundler/runtime owns transpilation.
